title: 5.6 Wants and Needs
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals, ask prices and order politely at a café or market.
goal: Say Ich möchte Saft. / Ich brauche Wasser. and the no-forms with kein.
grammar_function: Ich möchte / Ich brauche + food or drink; kein/keine/keinen for no.
speaking_outcome: Say what you want and need.
